newClaim.claimText: Engineering for Professionals (EP) implements a course-level color classification system for generative AI use: Red (GenAI use is prohibited, including drafting, editing and revision, unless the instructor or applicable course instructions explicitly state otherwise); Yellow (Moderate GenAI use is permitted with restrictions to support learning, and all use must be disclosed according to course expectations); and Green (Liberal GenAI use is permitted throughout the workflow, with expectations for transparency and accountability). Every EP course must have a course-level color designation; Yellow courses must also include assignment-level labels for all assessments and activities, while Red and Green courses need not apply categories at the assignment level. This policy applies strictly to EP courses and does not establish a blanket university-wide permission or exam authorization.

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
🚫 Red: GenAI use is not permitted
GenAI may not be used in any form.
Students must complete all work independently without GenAI assistance, including drafting, editing, or revision.

⚠️ Yellow: Moderate GenAI use is permitted, with restrictions
GenAI may be used in limited ways to support learning based on course policy.
All GenAI use must be disclosed according to course expectations.

✅ Green: Liberal GenAI use is permitted, with expectations for transparency and accountability
GenAI may be used throughout the workflow.
Disclosure of GenAI use may be required, depending on course or assignment guidelines.

course must have a course-level color. Yellow-designated courses must also include assignment-level labels (i.e., colors) for all assessments and activities. Red- and green-designated courses need not apply categories at the assignment level.

newClaim.claimText: Engineering for Professionals (EP) implements a course-level color classification system for generative AI use: Red (GenAI use is prohibited, including drafting, editing and revision, unless the instructor or applicable course instructions explicitly state otherwise); Yellow (Moderate GenAI use is permitted with restrictions to support learning, and all use must be disclosed according to course expectations); and Green (Liberal GenAI use is permitted throughout the workflow, with expectations for transparency and accountability). Every EP course must have a course-level color designation; Yellow courses must also include assignment-level labels for all assessments and activities, while Red and Green courses need not apply categories at the assignment level. This policy applies strictly to EP courses and does not establish a blanket university-wide permission or exam authorization.

evidence.evidenceSnippet:
🚫 Red: GenAI use is not permitted
GenAI may not be used in any form.
Students must complete all work independently without GenAI assistance, including drafting, editing, or revision.

⚠️ Yellow: Moderate GenAI use is permitted, with restrictions
GenAI may be used in limited ways to support learning based on course policy.
All GenAI use must be disclosed according to course expectations.

✅ Green: Liberal GenAI use is permitted, with expectations for transparency and accountability
GenAI may be used throughout the workflow.
Disclosure of GenAI use may be required, depending on course or assignment guidelines.
